turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
st time?
For the Timer Outlet Warmer and wax melts we discussed, here’s a simple first run:



Make sure the silicone dish is in place, then add 1–2 wax melt bears.


Plug the warmer into a wall outlet and choose a 3-, 6-, or 9-hour timer setting.


When it turns off, leave the dish and wax alone until they’ve cooled completely. Then lift out the silicone dish and pop out the wax when you’re ready to change scents.



There’s no need to use the whole pouch at once—starting with one bear is fine!
